reviews.title: 10/10 worth every penny!
reviews.comment: These lights are amazing, Just installed them in my first PC ever and the installation is super easy, The lights are cool and bright or somewhat dark if you want t take the brightness down. The color patterns are great with the app functionality. as long as you have the control which not all strimers come with so make sure you pay attention to your needs. The fit is perfect as well.
reviews.author: Ro
